consumer: mission::is_complete for an MGOAL_FIND_ITEM delivery quest, asking the yes/no question 'does the player possess the required quantity of type->item_id?' which the engine evaluates to gate quest completion.
scope: items reachable via crafting_inventory() (the character's carried items plus nearby/adjacent reachable items the engine counts toward the requirement), not only the character's own carried items.
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) — its body builds u.crafting_inventory() and tests tmp_inv.has_amount/has_charges(type->item_id, item_count) to compute the completion predicate.
divergence: The required item sits on the ground in an adjacent reachable tile (not carried): crafting_inventory() counts it so is_complete returns true, but a carried-items-only answer (Excerpt 3 scope) reports the requirement unsatisfied — exposing both a wrong class and a too-narrow reach.
